name: Workwear Outfitters
old_description: Workwear Outfitters is the world’s workwear authority, and leading manufacturer of innovative work apparel and footwear. We serve the workers who dedicate their lives to making our world work better. Based in Nashville, Tennessee, the company employs more than 5,800 people in facilities spanning the globe.
about:
Workwear Outfitters is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, where it oversees a global network of facilities. The company employs more than 5,800 people worldwide. No founding year or founders are disclosed in the source material.

The company manufactures work apparel and footwear under a family of brands that includes Red Kap, OOBE, and Workfitter. Its operations span design, production, and distribution of protective and functional workwear for a global workforce, with facilities spanning multiple continents.

Workwear Outfitters serves industrial, service, and governmental workers, supplying millions of end users with garments and footwear built for demanding job sites. Its customer base ranges from large industrial contractors to public-sector agencies.

The company differentiates itself through its Workfitter virtual sizing tool, which aims to improve the buying experience by helping customers find the right fit, and through its portfolio of established workwear brands that have long histories in the market.
